description: The song list (main) and the song windows (song-1, song-2, …): pick a songbook folder, then read and write the songs in it. There are no fixed fs scopes; the dialog plugin adds the folder the user picks (and the files directly in it) while the app runs. dialog:allow-message is for the unsaved-changes question (dialog.ask); dialog:allow-save is Save As, whose dialog adds the chosen file. The app's own `quit` command (Quit after the unsaved-changes check) needs no permission. The editor page sets the window title ("Edited") and, because it listens for close requests, closes the window itself with destroy(); its Close button asks the window to close (close()), which goes through the same question.
